<script>
(function () {
  var MAX_DIGITS = 16;

  var display = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calc-display"]');
  var opKeys = document.querySelectorAll('[data-op]');
  var tapeList = document.querySelector('.tape-list');
  var SYMBOLS = { '+': '+', '-': '\u2212', '*': '\u00d7', '/': '\u00f7' };

  // value: the number currently shown when no entry is being typed.
  //   Always the exact computed value. Never rounded; see format().
  // entry: the string being typed, or null.
  // locked: true when entry holds a finished number (made by ± from a
  //   result, or by closing a group). It displays formatted; the next digit
  //   starts fresh.
  // acc/op: the left operand and pending operator.
  // stack: the acc/op of each enclosing group, innermost last.
  // error: true after division by zero (or any non-finite result).
  // expr: the expression text entered so far at the current group level,
  //   ending with the pending operator when there is one. For the tape.
  // operand: the text of a closed group that is the current entry, or null.
  var state;

  function reset() {
    state = { value: 0, entry: null, locked: false, acc: null, op: null, stack: [], error: false, expr: '', operand: null };
  }

  function fail() {
    state = { value: NaN, entry: null, locked: false, acc: null, op: null, stack: [], error: true, expr: '', operand: null };
  }

  function compute(a, op, b) {
    switch (op) {
      case '+': return a + b;
      case '-': return a - b;
      case '*': return a * b;
      case '/': return b === 0 ? NaN : a / b;
    }
    return b;
  }

  function currentValue() {
    return state.entry !== null ? Number(state.entry) : state.value;
  }

  // Presentation only: rounds to at most 10 significant digits, drops
  // trailing zeros, and uses exponential notation only when the rounded
  // magnitude is >= 1e10 or < 1e-9. Never feed the result back into state.
  function format(n) {
    if (n === 0) return '0';
    var m = n.toExponential(9).match(/^(-?)(\d)\.(\d+)e([+-]\d+)$/);
    var sign = m[1];
    var digits = (m[2] + m[3]).replace(/0+$/, '') || '0';
    var exp = Number(m[4]);
    if (exp >= 10 || exp < -9) {
      var mantissa = digits.length > 1 ? digits[0] + '.' + digits.slice(1) : digits;
      return sign + mantissa + 'e' + (exp < 0 ? '-' : '+') + Math.abs(exp);
    }
    var intPart, fracPart;
    if (exp >= 0) {
      while (digits.length < exp + 1) digits += '0';
      intPart = digits.slice(0, exp + 1);
      fracPart = digits.slice(exp + 1);
    } else {
      intPart = '0';
      fracPart = new Array(-exp).join('0') + digits;
    }
    return sign + intPart + (fracPart ? '.' + fracPart : '');
  }

  // The text of the operand the next operator or equals will use. Mirrors
  // currentValue(): a closed group, the typed entry, or the shown value.
  function operandText() {
    if (state.operand !== null) return state.operand;
    if (state.entry === null) return format(state.value);
    return state.locked ? format(Number(state.entry)) : state.entry.replace(/\.$/, '');
  }

  function addTapeRow(expr, value) {
    var row = document.createElement('li');
    row.className = 'tape-row';
    row.setAttribute('data-testid', 'tape-row');
    var exprEl = document.createElement('div');
    exprEl.className = 'tape-expr';
    exprEl.setAttribute('data-testid', 'tape-expr');
    exprEl.textContent = expr;
    var resultEl = document.createElement('div');
    resultEl.className = 'tape-result';
    resultEl.setAttribute('data-testid', 'tape-result');
    resultEl.setAttribute('data-value', String(value));
    resultEl.textContent = format(value);
    row.appendChild(exprEl);
    row.appendChild(resultEl);
    tapeList.insertBefore(row, tapeList.firstChild);
  }

  function render() {
    var value = currentValue();
    var text = state.error ? 'Error' : state.entry !== null && !state.locked ? state.entry : format(value);
    display.textContent = text;
    display.setAttribute('data-value', String(value));
    display.setAttribute('data-error', String(state.error));
    display.setAttribute('data-open', new Array(state.stack.length + 1).join('('));
    display.style.fontSize = text.length > 12 ? Math.max(20, Math.floor(48 * 12 / text.length)) + 'px' : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < opKeys.length; i++) {
      var k = opKeys[i];
      k.classList.toggle('active', state.entry === null && state.op === k.getAttribute('data-op'));
    }
  }

  function inputDigit(d) {
    var e = state.entry;
    if (e === null || state.locked || e === '0') {
      state.entry = d;
      state.locked = false;
      state.operand = null;
    } else if (e === '-0') {
      state.entry = '-' + d;
    } else if (e.replace(/[-.]/g, '').length < MAX_DIGITS) {
      state.entry = e + d;
    }
  }

  function inputDot() {
    if (state.entry === null || state.locked) {
      state.entry = '0.';
      state.locked = false;
      state.operand = null;
    } else if (state.entry.indexOf('.') === -1) {
      state.entry += '.';
    }
  }

  // ± acts on the current entry. With no entry, it acts on the shown
  // result, or on a new 0 entry when an operator is waiting for its operand.
  // A group that was just opened counts as waiting for an operand too.
  function takeEntry() {
    if (state.entry !== null) return;
    var groupStart = state.stack.length > 0 && state.acc === null;
    state.locked = state.op === null && !groupStart;
    state.entry = state.locked ? String(state.value) : '0';
  }

  function toggleSign() {
    takeEntry();
    var e = state.entry;
    state.entry = e.charAt(0) === '-' ? e.slice(1) : '-' + e;
    if (state.operand !== null) {
      var t = state.operand;
      state.operand = t.charAt(0) === '-' ? t.slice(1) : '-' + t;
    }
  }

  // Immediate execution: an operator key first finishes the operation already
  // waiting, strictly left to right, with no precedence (2 + 3 × 4 = 20).
  // The display then always shows a real running result.
  function inputOperator(op) {
    if (state.entry !== null || state.op === null) {
      state.expr += operandText();
    } else {
      // Replacing the pending operator: drop its " x " suffix.
      state.expr = state.expr.slice(0, -3);
    }
    state.expr += ' ' + SYMBOLS[op] + ' ';
    state.operand = null;
    if (state.entry !== null) {
      var b = Number(state.entry);
      state.value = state.op !== null ? compute(state.acc, state.op, b) : b;
      state.entry = null;
    }
    if (!isFinite(state.value)) return fail();
    state.acc = state.value;
    state.op = op;
  }

  // Opens a group: the pending acc/op wait on the stack while the group is
  // worked out on its own. Ignored while a number is being entered.
  function openGroup() {
    if (state.entry !== null) return;
    state.stack.push({ acc: state.acc, op: state.op, expr: state.expr });
    state.expr = '';
    state.value = 0;
    state.acc = null;
    state.op = null;
  }

  // Finishes the group, restores the outer acc/op, and hands the group's
  // result to them as a finished entry.
  function closeGroup() {
    if (state.stack.length === 0) return;
    var b = currentValue();
    var result = state.op !== null ? compute(state.acc, state.op, b) : b;
    if (!isFinite(result)) return fail();
    var text = '(' + state.expr + operandText() + ')';
    var outer = state.stack.pop();
    state.acc = outer.acc;
    state.op = outer.op;
    state.expr = outer.expr;
    state.operand = text;
    state.value = result;
    state.entry = String(result);
    state.locked = true;
  }

  // Closes any groups left open, then finishes the calculation. A completed
  // calculation (an operator or a group, with a finite result) goes on the tape.
  function equals() {
    while (state.stack.length > 0 && !state.error) closeGroup();
    if (state.error) return;
    var text = state.expr + operandText();
    var calculated = state.op !== null || state.operand !== null;
    if (state.op === null) {
      if (state.entry !== null) {
        state.value = Number(state.entry);
        state.entry = null;
      }
    } else {
      var b = currentValue();
      state.value = compute(state.acc, state.op, b);
      state.entry = null;
      state.acc = null;
      state.op = null;
      if (!isFinite(state.value)) return fail();
    }
    state.expr = '';
    state.operand = null;
    if (calculated) addTapeRow(text, state.value);
  }

  // In the error state every key except clear is ignored.
  function press(action) {
    if (state.error && action !== reset) return;
    action();
    render();
  }

  document.querySelector('.keys').addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    var id = btn.getAttribute('data-testid');
    if (btn.hasAttribute('data-digit')) {
      press(function () { inputDigit(btn.getAttribute('data-digit')); });
    } else if (btn.hasAttribute('data-op')) {
      press(function () { inputOperator(btn.getAttribute('data-op')); });
    } else if (id === 'key-sign') {
      press(toggleSign);
    } else if (id === 'key-lparen') {
      press(openGroup);
    } else if (id === 'key-rparen') {
      press(closeGroup);
    } else if (id === 'key-dot') {
      press(inputDot);
    } else if (id === 'key-equals') {
      press(equals);
    } else if (id === 'key-clear') {
      press(reset);
    }
  });

  // Empties the tape only; the display and calculation are untouched.
  document.querySelector('[data-testid="tape-clear"]').addEventListener('click', function () {
    tapeList.textContent = '';
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
    if (ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey || ev.altKey) return;
    var k = ev.key;
    if (/^[0-9]$/.test(k)) {
      press(function () { inputDigit(k); });
    } else if (k === '.' || k === ',') {
      press(inputDot);
    } else if (k === '+' || k === '-' || k === '*' || k === '/') {
      press(function () { inputOperator(k); });
    } else if (k === '(') {
      press(openGroup);
    } else if (k === ')') {
      press(closeGroup);
    } else if (k === 'Enter' || k === '=') {
      press(equals);
    } else if (k === 'Escape' || k === 'Delete') {
      press(reset);
    } else {
      return;
    }
    ev.preventDefault();
  });

  reset();
  render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I couldn't reproduce this, so I haven't changed any code.

**What I tested** (headless Chromium, current `main`):
- **0.1 + 0.2 =** shows `0.3` on the display. The tape row reads `0.1 + 0.2` and then `0.3`. A screenshot confirms it.
- **1 ÷ 3 =** shows `0.3333333333` in both places.
- **Follow-on calculations** (a result reused in the next sum, groups, ±) also match the display.
- **8,000 random key sequences:** no tape line ever showed a number with more digits than the display would.

The tape formats its result with the same `format()` function as the display (`index.html:271`). It has done so since the tape was added.

**Where `0.30000000000000004` does exist:** in a hidden `data-value` attribute on the tape result (`index.html:270`). You'd only see it in the browser's developer tools or a tool that reads the page's HTML. The display has the same hidden attribute with the same raw value (`index.html:281`). A code comment says that value is meant to stay exact and unrounded. So on this point the display and the tape already match.

**Possible explanations:**
- The user is reading the page's HTML, or a copy made by a tool that reads `data-value`.
- The user has an older or different build than `main`.
- The steps differ from what they described.

To go further I'd need their exact key presses, their browser, and where they saw the number. If the hidden `data-value` is what they mean, I can round it too. That would drop the exact value the attribute is meant to keep, so I'd want your OK first.
